tokens.name: desktop
tokens.usage: The ground behind the board: the desktop, blurred and dimmed by `scrim`. Previews paint it flat.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Laid over the blurred desktop while Blink is open, so any desktop reads as one calm ground.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: The edge of the radial shading around the board.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Blink's amber: the lit tile of the mark, and nothing else. The interface uses `accent`.

tokens.name: mark-dim
tokens.usage: The two unlit tiles of the mark.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tint over a tile's background blur. A widget tile is this over the blurred desktop.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: A widget tile as it renders: `glass-tint` over the blur. Use it where glass cannot be drawn.

tokens.name: tile-raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces that float above tiles: the command bar, the launcher, menus, tile heads, the remove button.

tokens.name: web-ground
tokens.usage: A web tile before its page paints. Pages keep their own colours.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Track of a segmented control and resting fill of grouped controls.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Fill under the pointer on any control or row.

tokens.name: control-selected
tokens.usage: The selected segment, the selected launcher row, a pressed icon button.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: The hairline around tiles and floating surfaces, and between rows.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Hairline around a capsule control group (the command bar).

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Tile edge while arranging, and keycap edges. Decorative: arranging also shows with handles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 16.4:1 on `tile`, 15.0:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: details, hints, times, unselected segments, resting icons. 6.2:1 on `tile`, 5.9:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only, never text someone has to read. 2.9:1 on `tile`, 2.9:1 on `tile-raised`. Below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Small capitals over a group of rows (`caption`). 5.0:1 on `tile`, 4.8:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: the selected layout mode, the primary button, unread and due counts, sent messages, focus. At most one filled accent element per tile. 6.8:1 on `tile`, 6.2:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: An accent fill while pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill. 6.9:1.

tokens.name: bubble-in
tokens.usage: A received message's bubble in the Messages widget.

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: The quiet counterpart: night in the clock, websites in the launcher. 8.3:1 on `tile`, 7.5:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: late
tokens.usage: Overdue reminders and the calendar's now line. Always next to words, never colour alone. 6.5:1 on `tile`, 6.0:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: A rising figure, always with ▲. 10.2:1 on `tile`, 9.3:1 on `tile-raised`.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: A falling figure, always with ▼.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px outside the element.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small capitals over a group of rows. Uppercase, `section` colour.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Segments and buttons in the command bar.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Drag a tile to move it, or its edge to resize

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Text buttons and the brand name in the bar.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: A row's main line in widgets and the launcher.

styles.name: row-detail
styles.sample: Can we move the review to 3?
styles.usage: The line under a row title, `ink-2` (or `late`).

styles.name: tile-title
styles.usage: A tile's name in its head.

styles.name: search
styles.sample: Add a website, a widget or a file

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Times in the clock widget, tabular figures, with a small AM/PM in `caption` weight.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: The day number heading the calendar.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: A count in `accent`: unread messages, reminders due.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Inside a segmented control, between its track and thumb.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label; padding of the command bar.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Between controls in a group; row padding.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Tile padding for widgets; between a row's avatar or icon and its text.

tokens.name: tile-gap
tokens.usage: Between tiles on the board (the Appearance default).

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Launcher field padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Around empty states.

tokens.name: canvas-padding
tokens.usage: Board inset from the screen edges (the Appearance default).

tokens.name: chrome-inset
tokens.usage: Board inset from the top while pinned, leaving room for the command bar.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Launcher rows, calendar events, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Message bubbles; the corner nearest the sender tightens to `radius-row`.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The launcher and other floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles (the Appearance default; 0–40). Inner elements use the tile radius minus their inset.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: the command bar, segmented controls, buttons, tile heads, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Every tile at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: A tile being dragged in Arrange.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The command bar and tile heads, which float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The launcher and menus.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the command bar.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and icon buttons in the bar and tile heads.

tokens.name: size-segment
tokens.usage: Height of a segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: size-keycap
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of a keycap.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: A person's initials in the Messages widget.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: A two-line launcher or widget row.

tokens.name: figure-weight
tokens.usage: Weight of `clock` and `date` figures in the figures face.

tokens.name: duration-leave
tokens.usage: Blink leaving when the key is released, and anything being dismissed.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: Blink arriving, chrome fading in, crossfades (the Appearance default fade).

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Things moving into place: the command bar dropping in, the launcher opening, a thread sliding open.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: Tiles reflowing in Arrange and between Flow and Freeform.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between tiles arriving, from the pointer outward. Six tiles at most.

tokens.name: hover-delay
tokens.usage: Before a tile's head appears under a resting pointer.

tokens.name: ease-arrive
tokens.usage: Anything appearing or moving into place: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-leave
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: gathers speed and is gone.

tokens.name: spring-select
tokens.usage: A selection sliding between options. In CSS: `duration-move` `ease-arrive`.

tokens.name: spring-reflow
tokens.usage: Tiles moving to new places. In CSS: `duration-settle` `ease-arrive`.
